items.title_orig: What band did you see in a smaller venue before they got huge?
items.article_text:
For example, I'm and old and I saw Phish in a 250 person venue in New York City. A few years later they had sold out New Years Eve shows at Madison Square Garden. I also saw the Red Hot Chilli Peppers, Jane's Addiction, and Pearl Jam when they were playing 500-1,000 person venues.
 I guess the alternative could be what band did you see long past their prime in a small venue after they used to play huge venues?
 Either way, how'd it go?
